summary: The run is at its time boundary with roughly a minute of controller time left, so this turn makes no new claim and leaves the last accepted product in place; the file on disk is the refinement feedback product that the controller already executed (operation 54dd0a8a5f314c4b846f4e13b284d969), and preflight validated these exact bytes with valid:true, so resubmitting the same content carries no new knowledge and can be treated as an adjacent handoff. Final state of the investigation: audit spec v13 with every unit checked, and eleven confirmed in-scope obligations, each witnessed by a fixed artifact executed by the trusted runner and then reviewed with no open issue - election-term context published below an adopted term (substitute stream layer and production TCP transport); client requests left unresolved on an inactive raft and one accepted while leading left unresolved after shutdown; a second, different vote persisted for the same term; two leaders of one term, with the overlap-window variant a bounded negative that holds; GetConfiguration reporting index zero for a configuration established at index one; a reported commit index naming an entry the voting quorum does not store; a leader with a reachable quorum stepping down under the lease check; the commit context below applied state on the install path with the log left intact, again with the log truncated at the snapshot index, and again after a restart restoring the node's own snapshot; and VerifyLeader confirming leadership on non-voter acknowledgements with one non-voter against two voters and with two non-voters against three voters. Open items carried forward: the repair locations for the whole set with no source naming the intended layer; no external consumer exercised for the client-contract findings; the campaign path of a server without a vote only partly read though the voter-side refusal guard is located; the transfer path accepting a non-voter target and reporting success with no leader established, uncovered by any obligation; and the deferred third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed reachable-voter/non-voter layouts. Two anomalies were investigated and explained rather than reported as defects: the last-log report versus the effective last index after a snapshot is adopted (the cached value is independent of any actual truncation), and the non-voter election suspicion (refuted by the located suffrage guard on both the vote and pre-vote paths). Unused capacity at expiry: 2 audit units, 19 experiments, 9 semantic reviews and 12 revisions.
